  Guide to the City Commission Proceedings

The Oral Communication portion of the agenda is for members of the public to present items which are
not listed on the agenda, but are under the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Although no
action may be taken, the Commission and staff will follow up, at an appropriate time, on those items
needing response. Each speaker is limited to three (3) minutes.

Items in Consent Calendar Section A have already been considered by the Commission at a previous
meeting where the public was invited to comment, after which a decision was made. These items are not
subject to public discussion at this meeting because the vote taken at the previous meeting was final.
Resolutions concerning decisions made at previous meetings are for the purpose of memorializing the
decision to assure the accuracy of the findings, the prior vote, and any conditions imposed.

Items in Consent Calendar Section B have not been discussed previously by the Commission. If
discussion is desired, an item may be removed from the Consent Calendar for individual
consideration. Commissioners may indicate a negative or abstaining vote on any individual item by so

declaring prior to the vote on the motion to adopt the entire Consent Calendar. Items excluded from the
Consent Calendar will be taken up by the Commission following the action on the Consent Calendar. The
Commission first will take up the items for which public speaker requests have been submitted. Public
speakers shall follow the rules as set forth under Oral Communication.

Old Business items have appeared on previous agendas but have either been continued or tabled to this
meeting with no final action having been taken. Public comment shall follow the rules as set forth under
Oral Communication.

Items in New Business are items which are appearing for the first time for formal action. Public comment
shall follow the rules as set forth under Oral Communication.

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
above are on file in the office of the City Manager, and available upon request by emailing
KManisco@malibucity.org.

The City Hall phone number is (310) 456-2489. To contact City Hall using a telecommunication device
for the deaf (TDD), please call (800) 735-2929 and a California Relay Service operator will assist you. In
compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this
meeting, please contact Yolanda Bundy, Environmental Sustainability Director, at (310) 456-2489, ext.
229. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to
ensure accessibility to this meeting. [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADD Title II].

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing
agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements. Dated this 8th day of January
2024 at 5:00 p.m.

Subject:  Community Service Projects

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss community service projects and determine the
February and March 2024 beneficiaries.

DISCUSSION: At the June 26, 2023 Regular meeting, Council approved an assignment
for the Youth Commission to work with the Community Services Department to co-
sponsor six community service projects benefiting non-profit organizations.

Since September 2023, the Commission has organized three community service
projects, including,

  • A sock donation drive benefitting LA On Cloud 9
  • A blanket and towel donation drive benefitting the Agoura Animal Shelter
  • A beach clean-up day benefitting Heal the Bay

The Commission has three additional community service projects to complete by June
2024. The Commission may discuss community service opportunities and potential non-
profit beneficiaries.

Subject:  Health and Wellness Program

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Review and approve co-hosting a teen health and wellness
program focusing on stress management with the Community Services Department.

DISCUSSION: At the June 26, 2023 Regular meeting, Council approved an assignment
for the Youth Commission to work with the Community Services Department to
coordinate a teen health and wellness program focusing on stress management.

On Friday, February 2, 2024, the Community Services Department will host a
Breathwork and Stress Management Workshop at Malibu Bluffs Park from 4:00 PM to
5:30 PM. The complimentary program is designed for youth ages twelve through
seventeen and led by The Mindry, a local meditation, yoga, and wellness lifestyle brand
company.

Staff recommends the Commission co-host the Breathwork and Stress Management
Workshop and assist with marketing, volunteer recruitment, and other event
components.

Subject:  Environmental Sustainability Program

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide feedback regarding an Environmental
Sustainability Program.

DISCUSSION: At the June 26, 2023 Regular meeting, Council approved an assignment
for the Youth Commission to work with the Community Services Department to create a
program to promote environmental sustainability.

The City prides itself in being a leader in environmental stewardship and strives to
educate and create programs to reduce environmental impacts. The City’s primary
objectives regarding sustainability include energy, water conservation, pollution
prevention, waste reduction, coastal vulnerability, and outreach/events.

To meet the objectives, the City has coordinated various environmental programs such
as beach clean-up days, clean water initiatives, firescaping workshops, rain barrel
distribution, solid and organic waste recycling, shoreline restoration, and turf
replacement incentives. City Council has also passed ordinances regarding plastic bag
bans, the elimination of single-use cutlery, and the dark sky ordinance.

In 2023, the Commission hosted a virtual organic recycling workshop with the
Environmental Sustainability Department. The Commission is asked to review and
provide feedback for a spring 2024 program focusing on one or more of the City’s
environmental objectives.
